mina: Quick heads-up 20m planned regional failover validation for sa-east-1 on Tue 03:45 UTC. Goal: exercise warm-standby routing, KV sync, and SLO tagging. Expect brief 5xx tail.

jorge: Added. In-scope services?

mina: In-scope: inference workers (text-gen/chat), embeddings. Control-plane read-only ok; writers remain available.

claire: Who's primary?

mina: Jorge primary, Claire backup. Amaya will run loadgen. Todd handles mutes/comms.

sre-bot: maintenance created: maint-1801122334 | start: 2027-02-10T03:45:00Z | duration: 20m | owner: mina

amaya: Loadgen plan: 0->280 TPS in 4m, hold 12m, ramp down 4m. Mix 70/20/10. Tag runs failover/1801122334.

todd: Mute plan: scope mutes to streaming.disconnects and inference.5xx.alert for window; keep paging for control-plane writes.

mina: Abort criteria: global 5m error rate > 2.5% OR p95 > baseline+450ms for >5m OR streaming disconnects > 2% for >3m. If abort -> rollback region and re-enable routes.

jorge: Paste of alerts (promql) for exactness: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference"}[5m])) > 0.025 and histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])) by (le)) > (baseline_p95 + 0.45)

amaya: Preflight script `scripts/failover_preflight.sh sa-east-1` run nightly. I'll post results to thread.

todd: Ops-comm: I'll draft a short customer banner noting "resilience validation" and a contact link.

mina: Tag metrics with maintenance:failover_sa_east for SLO exclusion. Post-run: 1h validation sweep.

jorge: OK. Will run runbook and watch alerts. If preflight flags anything tonight we postpone. Otherwise proceed. :white_check_mark:
